task: Leg 20: opt-in realised-axis-minimum time-step bound; frozen slab arithmetic and spectral margin; default-path equivalence against the frozen solver; graded-fixture stability with a negative control

provenance.copy_note: Only retained grid coordinates, stored time steps and fixture inputs copied; no runtime reference imports. Copy log for steward to append to PROVENANCE.md.

region.in_plane_grid_note: x/y are the realized vendor mesh nodes (Linear X mesh probe for x, the x-normal plane monitor for y; field-and-power monitors snap to the nearest mesh cell). Slab-interior realized step 8.5616 nm = 40.0457 cells per material wavelength at 1.2 um in n = 3.5 (requested 8.5714 nm = 40). region.symmetry: none: the only boundary conditions set are PML on x min / x max and Periodic on y min / y max (see pml.applied_to / pml.periodic); no symmetric or anti-symmetric face

sources.span_y_note: in-session read-back after this run is y span = 6e-07 m, i.e. exactly the periodic unit cell and the requested value. The previously frozen artifact records 1.2e-06 m for the same build call because it read the property after RE-LOADING the saved .fsp, which is a different code path. The measured R3 experiment (raw/batch-2/normalization/source-area.json) shows vendor sourcepower(f) scales exactly with the periodic cell y span (ratio 2.000000000000 for 0.6 -> 1.2 um) while R/T stay put to 4e-15, so the denominator is integrated over the periodic unit cell and the recorded 1.2e-06 m does not enter it.

pml.profile: stretched coordinate PML (pml profile index 1); layers 8 (min 8, max 64); sigma 1, kappa 2, alpha 0, alpha polynomial 1, polynomial 3; auto scale pml parameters on; layers scale with the local mesh

stability.basis: Duration copied from the frozen 375.3 fs control (fixture run.simulation_time_cap_s). check_interval and growth_limit are the existing RunControl defaults. final_ratio_limit is the existing RunControl.decay_threshold default. No early shutoff.

cases.basis: The frozen fixture as registered: one-way normal-incidence Ez plane source. The slab spans the whole periodic y cell, so the field is y-invariant and this case exercises only the x operator. Gates as declared before run 20261019T095332Z-284029.

Same realised nodes, materials, PML and duration; a soft Ez point source at the frozen source position breaks the y symmetry and excites the full 2-D operator. Declared after run 20261019T095409Z-284487 showed S1 cannot excite y modes, and before any S2 run. post_source_ratio_limit 1.1 allows the staggered-time norm of a passive system to fluctuate; an instability at ratio 1.05 grows by about 1.88 per step. Decay is reported, not gated: a lossless slab across a periodic cell can trap guided energy.

grating.basis: $PARITY_REF/plan.md P0-b; historical measured residual, not newly recomputed from absent full grating coordinates.

assumptions: The bound is sufficient for the fork vacuum Yee operator on a rectilinear grid whose dual widths are means of adjacent primal widths (torchfdtd.boundaries.YeeGrid._prepare_boundaries). Nondispersive relative permittivity >= 1 and relative permeability 1 only shrink that operator; this is assumed, and the GPU fixture is the only material case run.
Native CPML with kappa >= 1 and sigma >= 0 is assumed not to lower the limit. PEC/PMC wall factors are assumed covered by the image argument. Neither is proven here.

A material, dispersive (ADE) or conformal stability limiter is NOT established in either project (class X). This bound does not establish one, and nothing here is inferred about one from vacuum layouts.
The vendor time-step selector mechanism is class X and stays X. Agreement of the per-axis-minimum form with stored vendor dt is a measured constraint on 28 frozen grids, not a selector claim.

gates.c1: per-axis-minimum form in SI on the stored coordinates reproduces vendor_dt_s to relative_tolerance on every frozen grid (registered C1)
gates.spectral: c*dt*sqrt(lambda_max)/2 < 1 at the stored vendor dt on every frozen grid, for the fork vacuum operator (Dirichlet truncation and the fixture boundary form), and at the opt-in dt on every native graded case (executor-declared before any run)
gates.equivalence: every compared default-path value bit-identical between $SOLVER_FROZEN and the run snapshot solver (registered C5)
gates.stability: C2: S1 and S2 pass their gated checks; N1 must raise FloatingPointError. Executor-declared limits are in stability.cases.

cases.basis: Reported, not gated: the y-invariant plane case cannot excite y modes, so at ratio 1.05 of the 2-D operator its 1-D ratio is about 0.74 and it stays bounded (observed in run 20261019T095409Z-284487).

negative_control.basis: dt set so that c*dt*sqrt(lambda_max)/2 = 1.05 for the fixture 2-D vacuum operator; the CFL guard is lifted in-process for these controls only. Shows the detector is not blind; it is not a measurement of any limiter.

native_graded_cases.basis: The fixture geometry meshed by the fork graded mesher: spans, slab, source position and band, x PML layer count from the fixture; mesh = the fixture nominal override dx; other mesher settings at fork defaults.

equivalence.basis: Default path only: time_step_rule is never set in these cases. Each case is evaluated in a child process against $SOLVER_FROZEN and against the run snapshot solver; time_step, cfl_time_step and rectangular_courant are compared as float hex, the full model dump and the mesh nodes as SHA-256.

rests_on.vendor_agreement: 28 frozen 2-D resolutions in 11 $PARITY_REF refs files (P0-b): air background, one lossless nondispersive n = 3.5 slab (lossless-slab-n3.5-d0.6), x PML, y periodic; 20 staircase and 8 conformal-variant-0 resolutions. Nothing 3-D, dispersive, multi-material or conformal-variant 1-2.
